name: CVS Pharmacy at 25761 Perdido Beach Blvd
description: The CVS location at 25761 Perdido Beach Blvd. Orange Beach, AL 36561 is a perfect location for your grocery and medication needs. With convenient hours and a wide variety of items, we are your full-service neighborhood drug store. CVS Health is conducting coronavirus testing (COVID-19) at this location. Patients are required to schedule an appointment for covid testing in advance. Limited appointments are available to qualifying patients due to high demand. Test types vary by location and will be confirmed during the scheduling process. Patients must bring their insurance card and proof of identity. Flu shots are offered at this CVS Pharmacy location. Schedule your flu shot ahead of time so you can get in and out faster. Provide your insurance information and answer questions online ahead of time. The store also serves as an active UPS Access Point where customers can drop-off and pick up packages with UPS tracking available. Pre-labeled, prepaid packages for 5 to 7 day ground and air delivery are accepted. UPS will collect all packages within 24 hours. Packages will be held for up to 7 days for customer pickup.
